articles.title: The Beatles In Cannes: All The Times John, Paul, George And Ringo Had A Groovy Time At The Festival, But Never As The Fab Four…
articles.summary: The prestigious Cannes Film Festival on the French Riviera has historically captivated numerous rock superstars with its unique glamour and cultural significance. The article highlights how legendary bands like The Rolling Stones were drawn to the event multiple times, showcasing the festival's broad appeal beyond just cinema. This international confluence of music and film underscores Cannes' enduring allure in global entertainment.

articles.title: Delhi High Court asks CCI not to pass final orders in Apple investigation
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed the Competition Commission of India (CCI) not to pass final orders in its probe against Apple. The investigation concerns Apple's alleged anti-competitive conduct related to its App Store. This interim court order highlights the ongoing regulatory scrutiny by Indian authorities over global tech giants' business practices within the national digital market.

articles.title: 'If Pakistan harbours terrorists, operates against India...': Army chief's stern message
articles.summary: Army Chief Gen Upendra Dwivedi issued a stern military warning to Pakistan, stating that if it continues to harbour terrorists and operate against India, Islamabad will have to face critical decisions. This message underscores India's resolute stance against cross-border terrorism, emphasizing the potential consequences of Pakistan's continued support for terror groups and highlighting the Indian Army's commitment to national security.

articles.title: UN event highlights India-Oman maritime ties through maiden voyage of stitched sail vessel INSV Kaundinya
articles.summary: The Indian Navy's traditional stitched sail vessel, INSV Kaundinya, had its maiden voyage from Porbandar to Muscat highlighted at a UN event. Speakers emphasized centuries-old maritime traditions and sustainable practices, aligning with UN Sustainable Development Goals. This showcases India's naval heritage and commitment to eco-friendly seafaring, gaining international recognition for its unique initiative and soft power projection.

articles.title: India news: PM Modi visits the Netherlands at start of Europe tour
articles.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi commenced a two-day visit to the Netherlands, aiming to significantly deepen bilateral ties. Discussions focused on expanding cooperation across critical sectors, including trade, investment, defense, and the burgeoning semiconductor industry. This strategic engagement seeks to bolster economic partnerships, technological collaboration, and strengthen India's diplomatic presence on the global stage, crucial for an aspirant's understanding of foreign policy.

articles.title: Court grants Musk’s bid to add Craig Federighi to Apple/OpenAI lawsuit, spares Cook
articles.summary: Craig Federighi, Apple's Senior Vice President of Software Engineering, has been named a document custodian in xAI's antitrust lawsuit targeting Apple and OpenAI. This move suggests an intensified legal scrutiny into the market practices of these tech giants, particularly concerning software development and potential monopolistic behavior. Federighi's role will involve managing and producing relevant internal documents for the ongoing legal proceedings, indicating an expanding scope of investigation.
